verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no user-definable rules that fire actions automatically on events. The closest items are manually triggered actions such as "Fix with v0", "Fix CI" and "Fix Conflicts", and "custom hooks", which refers to generated code rather than event-driven automation. API and SDK access is a developer building block, not a rule engine, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
